info.name: CMS BlueButton API Legacy (Not Being Used)
info.description:
THIS IS ONLY FOR REFERENCE OF WHAT IT WOULD LOOK LIKE WITH RESPONSE CODES. To use the Postman collection, you will need a Client Id and Client Secret. These can be obtained by creating a user account and registering an application in the Blue Button Sandbox, located at h[ttps://sandbox.bluebutton.cms.gov](https://sandbox.bluebutton.cms.gov).

Once you have setup and verified a user account, log in, click “Add an Application” and complete the "App Details" form. For the Callback URL, use [https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/callback](https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/callback) or [https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/browser-callback](https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/browser-callback) if you are using web based Postman. Also be sure to choose "Yes" to the beneficiary demographic data question.

In Postman, in the "CMS Blue Button Sandbox" collection editor, select the "Variables" tab. Copy the Client Id and Client Secret generated during the app registration into respective cells for both Initial Value and Current Value. Note the Client Id and Client Secret must exactly match the values from the app registration. After entering the Client Id and Client Secret, be sure to Save the collection

Within the Collection Editor, switch to the "Authorization" tab and click "Get New Access Token". Authorize via the Medicare login screens using the synthetic user accounts available in the sandbox (e.g. user=BBUser00000 and pwd=PW00000!). Upon return to Postman, click "Use Token" and then use any desired API calls under the V1 and V2 folders.
